# Engine test project

These small, unbranded source files exercise rendering, identity, localization,
resource isolation and saved-run checks. They are not starter letters and are
excluded from Core's wheel and source distribution. The test helper adds the
current shared library when creating a project.

Maintained starter content and its wording/page-count tests live in
ImmuKnow-Template. Core tests must not depend on that repository or copy its
letter prose and branding here.
